bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) exit 51;; esac
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
sha="faaae3e88c99a7cdfa85a70c91b6b585e3cd7a0d"
stage="$root/.worktrees/creator-entry-faaae3e"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 52
test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 53
newtag="create-videobot:creator-entry-faaae3e"
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$newtag")"
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || { echo CREATOR_LIVE_POLLER_COUNT_UNEXPECTED; exit 54; }
before="${ids[0]}"
oldtag="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$before")"
if test "$oldtag" = "$newtag"; then
  test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$before")" = "$newid" || exit 55
  echo CREATOR_EDITOR_ALREADY_LIVE=PASS
  exit 0
fi
case "$oldtag" in
 create-videobot:stars-sticker-shared-361267c) ;;
 *) echo CREATOR_LIVE_IMAGE_CHANGED_DO_NOT_OVERWRITE; exit 56;;
esac
oldid="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$before")"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$oldtag")" = "$oldid" || exit 57
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$before")"
files="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' "$before")"
base="${files%%,*}"
case "$base" in *compose.videobot.poll.yaml) ;; *) exit 58;; esac
test -f "$base" || exit 59
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" config --quiet || exit 60
overrides="$root/.worktrees/creator-entry-runtime-overrides-faaae3e"
mkdir -p "$overrides"
cat > "$overrides/live.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  videobot-poll:
    image: create-videobot:creator-entry-faaae3e
YAML
cat > "$overrides/rollback.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  videobot-poll:
    image: create-videobot:stars-sticker-shared-361267c
YAML
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$overrides/live.yaml" config --quiet || exit 61
changed=0
rollback() {
 rc=$?
 trap - ERR
 set +e
 if test "$changed" = 1; then
  docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$overrides/rollback.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps videobot-poll >/dev/null
  echo CREATOR_EDITOR_ROLLBACK_ATTEMPTED
 fi
 exit "$rc"
}
trap rollback ERR
changed=1
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$overrides/live.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps videobot-poll
sleep 8
mapfile -t after_ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$project" --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)
test "${#after_ids[@]}" -eq 1 || { echo CREATOR_EDITOR_POLLER_COUNT_INVALID; false; }
after="${after_ids[0]}"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$after")" = "$newid" || { echo CREATOR_EDITOR_IMAGE_NOT_APPLIED; false; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$after")" = true || { echo CREATOR_EDITOR_NOT_RUNNING; false; }
trap - ERR
echo CREATOR_EDITOR_DEPLOY=PASS
echo CREATOR_EDITOR_POLLER_COUNT=1
echo CREATOR_EDITOR_SOURCE_SHA="$sha"
